A math teacher asked his students how many hours of sleep they had the
night before a test. The information he received is summarized in the scatter plot above.

Given that none of the points overlap, which of the following statements are true?

- Only one student obtained a score of $90.$
- Only one student slept for $6$ hours.
- None of the students obtained a score lower than $75.$

The scatter plot above summarizes data collected by a Midwestern high school showing the relationship between the number of absences in a month and the class size. 

Given that none of the points overlap, which of the following statements are true?

- Only one class reported a total of $6$ absences in the month.
- Two classes have a total of $20$ students each.
- Only one class has more than $24$ students.
feedback.worked_solution:
Let's examine our scatter plot.

- Statement I is false. The scatter plot has two points whose vertical coordinate is equal to $6,$ namely, $(16,6)$ and $(20,6).$ This means that two of the classes each reported a total of 6 absences in the month.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13934290/assets/a62b1d5a63764b38013fdbdba9ba85a4495cd996a2d9f975dbe3d7eb89166234.png)

  

- Statement II is false. The scatter plot has only one dot whose horizontal coordinate equals $20,$ namely, $(20,6).$ This means that only one of the classes has a total of  $20$ students.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13934290/assets/3c41f2e111ef141511ec4f2faa655ddcea8f2b7e0b73bd37f0b1e142d5d60f14.png)

- Statement III is true. From the scatter plot, only one class has more than $24$ students. This class is represented by the point to the right of the vertical line.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13934290/assets/adcba37370fdac69b152a8d18ef710d5f665d9a3252376ea312808be7d08a407.png)

Therefore, the correct answer is "III only."
